title: Convert the resolver review page to the TypeScript stack
text: resolve review (packages/lup/src/lup/devtools/dev/resolve_review.py) still renders a static HTML page from Python strings with inline CSS. It becomes a fourth surface under packages/lup/web/, typed against the manifest it renders, built by Vite into the wheel like the explorer, wizard and supervisor. The last web UI outside the stack.

title: Open the three surfaces in a real browser
text: ledger explore, dashboard, and resolve supervise against a persisted run, plus the exported explorer page from a file. The pages are type-checked, built, route-tested, and mounted under happy-dom; no human has opened one. Needs a machine with a browser.

title: Measure whether codex queue wakes an idle Codex session
text: docs/platform-differentiation.md carries the row and says what settles it. Needs a signed-in Codex session (codex login) on this machine.

title: Verify the Vite build is deterministic on a second machine
text: The drift check rebuilds the bundles and compares them to what is committed; five worktrees on this machine agree, and a second machine with the same lockfile has not been tried.

title: Should the roster reach a session at prompt time, and how on Codex?
text: A UserPromptSubmit hook on Claude Code could fold the roster and inject only what changed since the session's last prompt. Codex's generated plugin declares PreToolUse, PostToolUse and PermissionRequest and no prompt-time event, so its substitute needs measuring: the watcher's codex queue nudge, or nothing.
